subject.title: fix: ClawHub search passes unbounded limit to the API

question: Should OpenClaw impose a user-facing maximum on `skills search --limit`, and if so what supported maximum should the CLI contract expose?
rationale: The live service accepts values above 100, while current OpenClaw exposes any positive integer; choosing a new maximum changes existing user-visible behavior and cannot be inferred from the plugin catalog's separate cap.

options.title: Define a skill-search maximum
options.body: Choose and document a supported maximum at the `skills search` CLI or lifecycle boundary while leaving generic ClawHub helpers policy-neutral.

options.title: Keep unlimited positive integers
options.body: Remove the shared cap and preserve the existing skill-search contract, relying on the service and response-body safeguards.

options.title: Adopt 100 globally
options.body: Approve 100 as a shared package-and-skill contract and document the intentional compatibility change before merge.

recommendation.title: Define a skill-search maximum
recommendation.body: Choose and document a supported maximum at the `skills search` CLI or lifecycle boundary while leaving generic ClawHub helpers policy-neutral.
